method.method_draft: First describe the image setup: CuSO4 solution with two inert carbon electrodes connected to a battery. From the text, note that copper plates onto the carbon cathode. Apply Cu2+ + 2e- -> Cu and Faraday's law: amount of Cu plated depends on total charge/current. With all other parts unchanged, choose the change that increases the applied voltage and therefore current. Conclude that replacing a 1.5 V battery with a 9.0 V battery increases the amount of copper plated.
